name: RsyncWebUI
description: RsyncWebUI is a web interface for rsync. Pick one or more sources and a destination from a file browser, tick the rsync options you want, save it as a task, and let it repeat on a cron schedule. Every run shows a live log with a progress bar and is kept in a history. Note: the container needs read and write access to the shares it backs up. By default /mnt/user and /mnt/disks are mounted.

paths.name: Configuration
paths.description: Database of tasks and run history. An ssh directory with SSH keys can live here too.

paths.name: Shares (/mnt/user)
paths.description: Access to the Unraid shares. Sources and destinations are picked from here.

paths.name: Unassigned Devices (/mnt/disks)
paths.description: External drives from Unassigned Devices as a backup destination. The rw,slave mode makes drives plugged in later visible inside the container.

paths.name: Remote Shares (/mnt/remotes)
paths.description: Mounted SMB or NFS shares from Unassigned Devices.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone used for schedules. Should match the server timezone.

variables.name: Allowed roots
variables.description: Comma-separated paths the file browser may show. Anything outside is rejected.

variables.name: Username (optional)
variables.description: Enables simple access protection. Leave empty for no login.

variables.name: Port (internal)
variables.description: Port the web server listens on inside the container.
